children: Nautilus Biotechnology established a new at-the-market (ATM) Sales Agreement with TD Cowen to sell up to $125 million of common stock, while simultaneously terminating its February 28, 2024 ATM agreement with the same counterparty. The new program allows Nautilus to direct timing, size, and pricing parameters, with TD Cowen earning up to 3.0% of gross proceeds as sales agent. No shares were sold under the prior program, which was mutually terminated, and the new offering will proceed under a freshly filed Form S-3 shelf once declared effective by the SEC. The actions are intended to provide flexible access to equity capital.
: At-the-market equity offering Sales Agreement (up to $125 million)
